goal: Detect duplicate public keys that share an x-coordinate in Tapscript Miniscript descriptors
Prevent third-party transaction malleation caused by duplicate keys satisfying multiple script branches
agreement: Substantive support confirmed by testing descriptor and miniscript test suites (fametrano)
Unaddressed style suggestion to use Check( for test cases that should succeed (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it enforces BIP-379 duplicate-key invariants for Tapscript descriptors
Prevents third-party malleation when keys differing only in parity byte serialize identically on-chain
